turns.t: Good afternoon, come in. Did you manage to park all right? The lot was packed when I got in this morning.
Oh, don't ask, doctor. I went round three times. And this humidity, my shirt is sticking to me already.
The monsoon is making everyone miserable. Sit down, make yourself comfortable. What can I do for you?
It is my collarbone, doctor. I broke my collarbone three months ago, fell off my scooter on a wet road. They said it has healed, but I am still having pain in the collarbone.
I'm sorry to hear that. Tell me about the pain.
It is a dull ache mostly, right on top of the bone. Sometimes sharp, like a pinch, when I lift my arm up.
The sharp pinch comes when you lift the arm. Anything else that sets it off?
Carrying my laptop bag on that shoulder. What to do, I have my files.
So the bag and lifting the arm make it worse. Does anything help?
A hot water bag in the evening helps a little.
Mothers are often right. How bad is the pain on a normal day?
Moderate, I would say. Not unbearable, but I notice it all day.
Okay. And the shoulder itself, does it move freely?
There is a stiffness in the shoulder, mostly in the morning. It loosens up after I move around.
Morning stiffness that eases once you get going. Anything else you've noticed?
Yes, there is a bump. A small bump right in the middle of the bone, which was not there earlier.
I'll have a look at that shortly. Have you had any numbness in your fingers on that side?
No, no numbness. I can type, I can hold my cup, all normal on that front.
Good. And any pain in the neck as well?
No, the neck is fine. It is only the collarbone area.
That's very helpful. Now a few general questions. Any problems with breathing or a cough since the fall?
No, nothing like that.
Well done. Any longer-term health conditions I should know about?
Just the thyroid. I have an underactive thyroid, since about five years.
And are you taking something for it?
Yes, thyroxine, 50 micrograms every morning, on an empty stomach. My wife reminds me.
That's a clever reminder. And what work do you do?
I am an accountant, in a firm near the station. Desk work mostly, with lots of files going between offices.
That explains the bag. Do you smoke at all?
No, no, I have never smoked.
Good for you. Right, let me look at the shoulder. Could you take your shirt off on the left side, and I'll feel along the bone?
Sure.
No problem at all. I can feel a firm, bony bump over the middle of the collarbone, and it's a little tender when I press.
Ouch. Yes, that is the sore spot. Is it something serious, doctor?
Let me finish looking. There's no redness and no warmth, so no sign of infection. Now lift your arm up slowly for me.
It goes up, but there, there is the pinch again. At the top.
I see that. The arm goes nearly all the way up, and the pinch is right where the bone healed.
So what is the bump? I thought the bone had joined wrongly.
This is the usual thing. When a collarbone heals, the body lays down extra bone around the break, like a patch on a tyre. This looks like a healing callus, and the ache is the bone settling down.
A patch on a tyre. So it is a good thing?
It's the body doing its job. It may stay as a bump for months, and be a little tender while the bone remodels.
Okay, that is a relief. My wife was imagining the worst.
So the key points: the bone has healed, the bump is extra healing bone, and the ache should fade over the coming months.
Months? Doctor, can I do something about it meanwhile?
Keep up the hot water bag, that's a fine idea. And gentle shoulder stretches a few times a day will ease the morning stiffness.
What kind of stretches?
Simple ones. Slowly circle the shoulder, then reach the arm forward and up as far as is comfortable. Ten times, morning and evening, no forcing.
That I can do, right after my tea. And the bag?
Switch to a rucksack with two straps so the weight is shared, and give the shoulder a rest from heavy loads for a while.
To repeat the main points: hot water bag, stretches, two straps, and the bump is just healing bone.
Yes, I have it. Thank you, doctor. I was really worried about nothing, it seems.
Not nothing, it was right to ask. Mind the wet floor on your way out.
I will. Hopefully the rain stops before I find my scooter!

physical_examination.finding: firm, bony bump over the middle of the collarbone

clinical_actions.description: Continue hot water bag, do gentle shoulder stretches, carry bag with two straps and avoid heavy loads
